In
enzymology
,
(+)-borneol dehydrogenase
(
EC
1.1.1.198
) is an
enzyme
that
catalyzes
, the
chemical reaction
(+)-borneol
+
NAD
+
H
+
H
+
(+)-camphor
+
NADH
The two
substrates
of this enzyme are (+)-borneol and oxidised
nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide
(NAD
+
). Its
products
are (+)-camphor, reduced NADH, and a
proton
.
[
1
]
[
2
]
[
3
]
This enzyme belongs to the family of
oxidoreductases
, specifically those acting on the CH-OH group of donor with NAD
+
or NADP
+
as acceptor. The
systematic name
of this enzyme class is
(+)-borneol:NAD
+
oxidoreductase
. This enzyme is also called
bicyclic monoterpenol dehydrogenase
.
